(2) A 2015 photo shows a woman in a striped shirt outdoors at night near water, holding a young child. (3) A 2015 close-up shows a man with glasses looking surprised in a cluttered room, followed by his 2025 self wearing a black mask and glasses, smiling and giving a thumbs-up while working at a laptop in a professional workspace. (4) A 2015 photo of a girl in a school uniform sitting on a wooden chair in a grassy field transitions to her 2025 self—now a young woman with glasses, smiling confidently while holding a stylus at a desk with a computer monitor. (6) The muscular man from the first phase appears in a professional studio setting, speaking animatedly to the camera while holding a plush toy that resembles his own cartoon persona. He stands before a blue backdrop for a 10th-anniversary exhibition. (7) He is joined by another person, and both hold their respective cartoon plushies while moving with high energy in front of the exhibition banner. (8) The video concludes with a black screen featuring white textual information.
